entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
Jane Smith, order number 774-B. Look, I don't have a lot of time, is this something you can do or not?
Yes, absolutely. I just have to follow the process. I've got your order here. So I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I just don't like it. The whole interface is **hard to use** and frankly, very **confusing**. I even read the **user manual**, and I still can't get it to do what I want. I just **expected more** for the price. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand your frustration. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered on December 15th, so about 20 days ago.
So, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Oh. Okay. That's better. Fine, send the email. Thanks.
You're welcome, Jane. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
